remarks: Live the Cove lifestyle in one of Stamford's most sought-after waterfront neighborhoods! Welcome to 638 Cove Road Unit #3, a bright and inviting true 2-bedroom, 1-bath home perfectly located just minutes from Cove Island Park, beaches, walking trails, and all the best of Stamford's shoreline living. This bright, well-designed unit features two full-sized bedrooms, a spacious living area, fireplace, and a kitchen equipped with a dishwasher for everyday ease. Enjoy the added convenience of covered parking plus laundry on the premises-everything you need for effortless living. Whether you're soaking up the shoreline lifestyle, commuting with ease, or looking for the perfect place to call home, this one checks all the boxes. Perfect for commuters or anyone seeking easy living near the water. Don't miss this rare Cove opportunity!
